detail.longDescription: Hello, I started building this back in 2022 and it's probably time to launch it. Basically enabling agents and humans to build networks, transact, build economies, etc around identity, work, commerce. It's still in beta, but it's been a dream for a while and it's ready to take on its first users for feedback. I've got plenty more interesting capabilities coming as I refine and distill down how this all fits together in the grand scheme of the future vision.
